Abstract. This document describes the Nexora product suite: NexaDesk (AI-powered helpdesk), NexaFlow (workflow
automation) and NexaInsight (analytics). It explains architecture, key features, subscription plans and pricing, service level
agreements, security and compliance, data residency, supported integrations, usage limits and system requirements, and
outlines the onboarding process for a new customer workspace.
Keywords: NexaDesk, NexaFlow, NexaInsight, RAG, helpdesk automation, subscription plans, SLA, SOC 2, integrations
1. Product Suite Overview
Nexora Technologies provides three products on a shared platform. NexaDesk helps support teams resolve
tickets faster with AI triage and answer suggestions grounded in the customer's knowledge base. NexaFlow
automates repetitive processes using a no-code workflow builder. NexaInsight turns support and workflow data
into dashboards and scheduled reports. All products are exposed through the Nexora Platform API
(NX-ENG-001).
Figure 1. Nexora product suite and shared platform.
2. Key Features
2.1 NexaDesk
• AI triage: classifies tickets by topic, urgency and sentiment and routes them to the right queue.
• Answer suggestions (RAG): agents see draft replies grounded in the customer's knowledge-base articles
with source links, reducing hallucination risk.
• Multilingual: English and Urdu supported for triage, suggestions and summaries; Arabic in beta.
• SLA timers and escalation rules, conversation summaries, and macros for common answers.

2.2 NexaFlow
• Drag-and-drop builder with more than 150 pre-built actions and triggers (ticket events, schedules,
webhooks).
• Human approval steps, conditional branches and retries; every run is logged for audit.
2.3 NexaInsight
• Prebuilt dashboards for ticket volume, first response time, resolution time and CSAT.
• Scheduled reports by email, CSV and PDF export, and custom metrics on the Growth and Enterprise plans.

5. Security, Compliance and Data Residency
• Nexora holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 certifications and supports GDPR data-processing
agreements.
• Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Role-based access control and audit logs are
available on all plans.
• Customer data is not used to train shared AI models. AI features call approved model providers under
zero-retention terms.
• Data residency: customers choose Mumbai (India), Frankfurt (Germany) or Bahrain at workspace creation;
the region cannot be changed later without migration.
• Backups are taken daily and retained for 35 days; recovery point objective is 24 hours and recovery time
objective is 4 hours.

7. Customer Onboarding
Figure 3. Typical onboarding steps for a new NexaDesk workspace.
A typical Growth-plan customer goes live in 2 to 3 weeks. Enterprise implementations include a project plan,
SSO configuration and a security review, and usually take 6 to 8 weeks.
